name: Inferno Torch
body:
Your blazing torches burn hotter than normal.

Prerequisite(s): Pyro blazing torch special torch attack class feature, base attack bonus +5.

Benefit(s): Your blazing torches inflict an extra 1d8 fire damage, instead of 1d4. At 14th level, this improves to 2d6, and at 18th level, it improves to 2d8. Also, creatures with light blindness or light sensitivity are affected by your blazing torches as if they were daylight spells.
